sources.name: Reuters: Stocks trade cautiously in Asia, Brent off six-month top

figures.label: Brent crude
figures.evidence: Brent oil slipped 1.6% to $114.88 following reports that Qatari mediators were in Tehran on Sunday as part of an effort to de-escalate regional tensions in coordination with the US.

figures.label: Brent crude move
figures.evidence: Brent oil slipped 1.6% to $114.88 following reports that Qatari mediators were in Tehran on Sunday as part of an effort to de-escalate regional tensions in coordination with the US.

figures.label: US crude
figures.evidence: US crude futures fell 1.9% to $101.29 a barrel.

figures.label: US crude move
figures.evidence: US crude futures fell 1.9% to $101.29 a barrel.

figures.label: Brent weekly rise
figures.evidence: Brent futures jumped 6.2% last week to their highest weekly close since mid-2022 as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns about energy supplies.

figures.label: Nikkei move
figures.evidence: Japan's Nikkei dipped 0.5% after losing 4.0% last week.

figures.label: South Korea main index move
figures.evidence: South Korea's main index fell 1.1%, having shed almost 20% so far this month.

figures.label: Chinese blue chips move
figures.evidence: Chinese blue chips lost 1.0%, as China's ruling Communist Party began its fifth plenum in Beijing.

figures.label: MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan move
figures.evidence: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares excluding Japan eased 0.1%.

figures.label: S&P 500 futures move
figures.evidence: On Wall Street, S&P 500 futures edged up 0.1%, while Nasdaq futures were flat.

figures.label: EUROSTOXX 50 futures move
figures.evidence: In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures firmed 0.3%, while DAX futures gained 0.3% and FTSE futures gained 0.4%.

figures.label: DAX futures move
figures.evidence: In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures firmed 0.3%, while DAX futures gained 0.3% and FTSE futures gained 0.4%.

figures.label: FTSE futures move
figures.evidence: In Europe, EUROSTOXX 50 futures firmed 0.3%, while DAX futures gained 0.3% and FTSE futures gained 0.4%.

figures.label: US 10-year Treasury yield
figures.evidence: Yields on 10-year Treasuries were at 4.97%, well off a peak of 5.36% hit early in the month.

figures.label: Gold
figures.evidence: In commodity markets, non-interest-bearing gold was a fraction firmer at $4,001 an ounce, having fallen more than 4% last week.

figures.label: US core inflation forecast
figures.evidence: A key reading on US core inflation should show cost pressures remained elevated at 3.1% in September.

figures.label: US annualized growth forecast
figures.evidence: The economy is forecast to have grown at a brisk 3.2% annualised pace thanks in part to furious spending on data centres.

figures.label: December Fed hike probability priced by markets
figures.evidence: Markets assume the US Federal Reserve will stand pat, but they imply an 80% chance that it will pull the trigger in December.
